I replied to Pree in her DM (DV04CAL0002) to say I couldn't find a named escalation contact for Marrow Agrisupply in anything she can see.

- **What I checked:** her DM with me, #central-team, #central-random, #inc-tansley-carrier-api, #general and #help-it-ops, plus the public Central team digests. There are no Marrow account files (CRM, profile or contracts) in the share.
- **Closest lead:** a 9 Jun thread in #central-team. Hollis said Marrow had escalated through their store ops team, and Pree planned to call store ops and get one receiving lead per store. Nobody at Marrow is named there.
- **Suggested next steps:** use any contact Pree got from those June calls, ask Hollis, or have someone check the Marrow CRM record.

I didn't search messages beyond Pree's own channels, and I didn't guess at a name.
